events.name: A Challenge Answered

options.text: Goodbye, [character].

events.text: For the ruler of [rival] to face a challenger in single combat... speculations grow wild as crowds gather through [city]. And you do not disappoint. [character] shows incredible finesse, but your tireless guard wears him down until, in a flash, your blade finds his chest, and the ground stains red.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Duel

options.text: It will take time to recover from this loss.

events.text: After a duel of spears, your heir, [character], dies of severe injuries in the early hours of the morning.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Duel

options.text: I feel a certain sense of pride.

events.text: After a glorious spear duel, your General, [character], dies of severe injuries in the early hours of the morning.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Father's Touch

options.text: [character] is clearly responsible. He must face exile.
This looks suspicious, but we have no proof of foul play.

events.text: After news reached [character] of the duel between [character] and [character], he paid a visit to each of their tents to pray for their health. However, [character] would not wake in the morning, and seems to have died in his sleep.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Full Recovery

options.text: I never doubted my abilities.

events.text: Working carefully, you and [character] rebalance your humors with a combination of herbs and targeted bloodletting. Soon you begin to feel the purifying effects of the procedure, and you adjourn to your chambers for a much-needed rest. Several days later, you seem to have made a full recovery.

events.author: Solver
events.name: A Game at Dinner

options.text: Quickly switch plates with [character].
This is the time for direct action. Plunge your knife into [character] instead of the dinner!
If you eat just half and leave under the pretense of not feeling well, you'll be able to prepare an antidote.
Look [character] in the eye as you reveal your knowledge of her plot.
You realize you have made a remarkably bad decision as you cannot think of any way out of the situation.

events.text: You are seated at dinner with [character] and [character], nobody but the three of you, and some servants, in the expansive hall. You notice a few furtive glances at you from Gigis, one of [character]'s most loyal servants. Is she the one who has been chosen to poison your meal? As [character] berates your husband, the main course, a roast bird, is brought out and [character]'s face now plainly betrays her anticipation. Gigis slices the bird and serves the three of you. Your next move will decide whether you and [character] will finally be free of her meddling - or fall victim to her schemes.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Gift

options.text: Matters of state must come first.
[character] has no right to order about [rival].

events.text: Despite attempts at a low profile, it comes to the attention of [character] that a member of the [rival] court is visiting [city]. [character] is brought before an audience with [character], where he reveals he has a grand crown intended as a gift of friendship for [character], and [character] is to bear the gift back to [city] and present it.

events.name: A Gift

options.text: Accept the gifts.
Refuse the gifts.

events.text: Despite attempts at a low profile, it comes to the attention of [character] that the heir to the [rival] throne is visiting [city]. [character] is ushered into an audience with [character], where [character] is offered flowery compliments and gifts both great and small.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Hero Appears

options.text: My little rabbit foot is all grown up!

events.text: The crowd are amazed to hear of [character] heroic feats, which you tell at great, great length. Finally [character] and [character] are wed. Another successful day as [title]!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A High Price

options.text: Only the court shall hear of this plot.
The [rival] will pay for this treachery.
Make an attempt to reconcile with [character].

events.text: The young servant girl awaits you in the gardens, but instead of imparting a kiss, she delivers another message... According to her, [character], [title] of [rival], has ordered your assassination, and he is willing to pay a high price for your head on a platter.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Kingly Gift

options.text: Follow [character] lead.
Gently place his hand back on his lap.

events.text: While [character] engages in a raucous debate with [character], you are surprised to discover [character] hand placed delicately on your thigh. When you catch his eye, he smiles and makes to lead you by the hand somewhere quieter.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Matter of Trust

options.text: We await your decision.

events.text: The [rival] do not know what to make of our request for a truce. [character] is said to have shaken his head in resignation. "All of this intrigue for an end to hostilities. We will consider it, but we are not accustomed to such dirty diplomacy." He promises a speedy decision. "We are wary of you [rival]. It is a matter of trust."

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A New Hope

options.text: The crowd roars their approval!

events.text: In the early hours of the morning, tens of thousands watch the showdown between four hundred and fifty priests of the old gods and [character]. [character] storms up the mountain, righteous anger burning in his eyes, and confronts the sacred priests to the delight of the crowd. "My people, choose! If Jehovah is supreme, then follow him. If these gods are supreme, then follow them! Bring us two bulls. Slaughter them here on two alters, but do not light them on fire." [character] pauses for a moment, wild-eyed. "Call on your gods, and I shall call on Jehovah. Let the true god answer by fire!"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Ransom

options.text: All we have to do is wait.

events.text: Our demand for a huge payment from the [rival] treasury has been met with outrage. Such a request would always be an insult. But this is wartime! Every flake of gold is precious and could be the difference between victory or defeat. [character] has ordered his ministers to examine the situation and prepare a response.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Shield of Flame

options.text: Fully embrace [religion].
Refuse to convert, but protect their beliefs.
Refuse to listen to their [religion] lies.

events.text: Following [character] conversion to [religion], tales continue to spread through the army. More and more soldiers are going into battle under the sign of the cross and you hear that [character] has also agreed to be baptized. The generals soon approach, asking that you accept [religion] as the true faith of [rival].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Slip of the Tongue?

options.text: [character] attempt at a neutral expression was... unsuccessful.

events.text: The next morning, you spend some time reflecting on your pounding headache and how exactly you could have chosen your phrasing so poorly.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Surprise

options.text: Perhaps we should stay together.
Fine, but the divorce stands.

events.text: After consulting the calendars for the past year, your royal doctors have found that you are indeed the father of [character]'s child. She never brandished any ill intentions. Congratulations!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Tale of Misfortune

options.text: I await whatever may come.

events.text: With a frown, the haruspex tells a heartbreaking story of tragedy and misfortune. "Malevolent spirits will bring you to your knees, and you must be ready for the worst." When she departs the palace, she leaves behind an aura of doom. You regret spending money on this prediction.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Achievement

options.text: Achievement.

events.text: Achievement

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Across Culture

options.text: No, of course not, it's just, you see...

events.text: The impassive stare continues. "Is my honor so funny to you?"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Across Culture

options.text: You had me going!

events.text: The impassive stare continues for a very long five seconds. Then, abruptly, [character] himself bursts into uncontrollable laughter.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ambush

options.text: Rip a hole in the sack.
Roll the sack into the nearby water.
I cannot seem to free myself.

events.text: The moment that you arrive in the gardens, you realize your mistake. There is no young servant girl, only a trio of sinister [rival] figures with gleaming daggers. You are thrust into a damp, smelly sack and dragged away. This will teach you to thirst for romance. As the kidnappers haul you to their boat, there may be a chance to escape...

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Unexpected Guest

options.text: Go to confront [character].
This betrayal will be answered for.
Interesting.

events.text: The noises fade as you wait by the chamber's entrance, but some time later your patience is rewarded by the sight of [character] making a careful exit.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Unorthodox Tithe

options.text: I think I shall not treat the gods so lightly in the future.
Enough, [character]. Just... enough.

events.text: "Thank you, my lords, for the generous offerings." The priestess allows herself a quirk of the lips as she gathers assorted coins and finery into a jangling bag. "Please, do come again any time, but now, I must prepare for the dawn prayers." As, moments later, you and [character] stand looking at each other outside on the temple stoop, he only shrugs and says, "Well, I guess that answers that."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: There is no time. The fire is upon you. Searing agony shoots through your body. Thankfully, you do not survive for long.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: The mob washes over you like a tidal wave. The first knife entering your body is shockingly painful, but the tenth is hardly noticeable. As you collapse you can faintly hear the sounds of your guardsmen rallying to your defense, but it is far too late for you.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: A vicious shove sends you flying over the railing. The attack is so sudden that you are still drawing a breath to scream when you slam into the ground below.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: You hit the water below before you have time to draw a breath, and what air you had in your lungs is driven out by the impact with the surface. You struggle to swim but your elaborate clothes, a symbol of your wealth and status, drag you inexorably downwards. Your chest burns for air and eventually you can hold off trying to inhale no longer. Water floods your lungs...

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: There is no time to react, the falling block seems to take up the entire sky above you. Before you can move it lands on your head with a sickening thump.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: Desperately, you grab at a protruding ledge, but you are unable to get a grip. You plunge into the pit and have only a moment’s glance at the sharp spikes below before they pierce your body.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You die!

options.text: Everything is going dark...

events.text: You loose a panicked arrow towards the wolves, which misses, before attempting to flee, but the wolves are on you within moments! Sharp teeth bite into your flesh and pull you to the ground, but mercifully powerful jaws snap your neck before the feeding begins in earnest.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: Moving faster than you ever have before, you dive into a nearby alcove. The jet of flame streams by, shooting through the area you just vacated. But while the alcove has granted temporary safety, there is no way out. You are trapped! You hear the creak of leather flexing as the bellows are pumped again, but no further flames wash down the corridor. You hear several more increasingly forceful pumps until suddenly there is a deafening boom and a massive burst of fire rushes down the corridor! You dare to peek out once the conflagration has passed and see that where the strange man once stood there is only a burning crater.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: With an agility you did not know you possessed, you scramble up a nearby tree. Seeing nothing to lose and no other options, you run along an outstretched branch and leap onto the roof of an adjacent building. The mob’s cries of frustration turn to terror as large numbers of guardsmen converge on the garden below.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: A vicious shove sends you staggering forward to painfully slam into the railing, but luckily it was not quite strong enough to send you over the edge. You turn just in time to block a strike from an unknown attacker. Twisting your body, you are able to use the momentum of his attack to send him flying from the balcony with a despairing scream.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: You barely have time to take a deep breath before you hit the water, but that gives you enough time to struggle out of some of your heavier clothes and kick your way back to the surface. You flounder to the bank and lie there for a time to recover. It dawns on you that this was no accident, someone tried to kill you!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: The block narrowly misses you, shattering into shards which painfully pelt your exposed skin, but otherwise leave you unharmed.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: Desperately, you grab at a protruding ledge and are able to avoid plummeting into the newly-opened pit. After a terrifying moment of dangling there you are able to pull yourself up. After regaining your composure you stare into the hole in the floor and see sharp spikes at the bottom of a long drop. Who could have set such an elaborate trap?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack: You survive!

options.text: A close one!

events.text: Without hesitation you draw and fire an arrow into the chest of the largest beast, who collapses with a yelp. The other wolves seem startled by their leader’s demise, and in their moment of uncertainty you charge forward shouting as loudly as you can. It is too much for the surviving creatures, who turn and flee.

events.name: Appeal Process

Make some suggestive and impossible to misinterpret proposals.
Discuss affairs of state.

events.text: [character] looks stunning as he makes his entrance to the banquet hall. You invite him to a seat by your side.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Back in Command

options.text: May he rot in a pit for eternity.

events.text: Shattering the oncoming mercenaries, you lead your soldiers in a resounding victory. Once the fighting has ended, you race back to the capital to confront [character]. Seeing the "dead" [title] standing before them once again, the court orders the arrest of [character]. Although back in your rightful place, there is still the problem of the [tribe] invasion that [character] encouraged as part of his plan. To arms!

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Betrayal Answered

options.text: Why yes, you may be excused from the meal. I am nothing if not magnanimous.

events.text: [character] takes it remarkably calmly, as you inform him over dinner that the meat of choice in this particular feast is the flesh of his own son.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Betrothal

options.text: This will bind us in an alliance before.
This marriage will finally see an end to the war.
No, the deal is off.

events.text: [character] oversees the ceremony where [character] and [character] are united in the eyes of, bringing your two nations closer together than ever before.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Bloodsport

options.text: No! I was supposed to… win…

events.text: You see your opponent stagger and know this is your chance, but even as you thrust your sword towards him, an icy shock hits you! His staggering was a feint, and you have fallen for it. Your shock doesn’t last long though, as your foe’s weapon cleaves into your neck. Blood spurts and the world starts going dark…

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Bloodsport

options.text: I am the champion!

events.text: Your feint lures your opponent into a wild thrust, certain of victory, but his triumphant expression quickly turns to horror as you slip to the side and slice your blade across his throat. Warm blood sprays over your face while he gurgles out his last breaths. You raise your sword in the air, basking in the cheers of the crowd.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Bodies on the Road

options.text: I gambled, and I lost.

events.text: Messages from [rival] arrive all through the night, keeping the royal household on edge until the sun finally rises. Our attempts to infiltrate the spy network of [character] have collapsed in spectacular fashion. Not only has the young Heir discovered the plots against him, but he has also alerted the [rival] [title], [character]. The bodies of our agents are later found strewn across the roads leading into [city].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Bored Monkey

options.text: It was a terrible idea, anyway.

events.text: Despite its intense combat training, the adorable court monkey does not seem particularly interested in assassinating [character]. We advise that you abandon this foolhardy mission.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Bright Outlook

options.text: I await whatever may come.

events.text: Smiling broadly, the haruspex reveals a prediction that lifts the spirits of everyone in court. She may be telling you only what you want to hear, but good news is always welcome. The entrails have spoken.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Champion!

options.text: My ride was blessed.

events.text: You cross the finish line on your victorious steed, Champion, to the cheers of the [city] crowds! No one will forget this race. Not for many generations. You return to the capital with your legend fixed in the minds of the people.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Chariot Diplomacy

options.text: Long live [character]!

events.text: [character] and [character] ride out to parley with [character] outside the city walls. "Is it peace then?" [character] asks. "There can be no peace so long as the witchcraft and misery of your family persist." [character] draws a warbow from his chariot and kills [character] and [character]. [character] turns to the messengers on horseback behind him. "Ride to [city], find [character], throw him from the palace walls, and then send letters to the families commanding them to pledge their fealty. No more need to die. For as [character] foretold, I am the rightful King."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Cheating at the Games

options.text: Alas!

events.text: [character] attempts at cheating were discovered and seen as an insult to. The [family] have been forced to pay for a statue of the disgraced athlete to stand at [city] as a permanent reminder of his shame. Whether he ran-away from shame or has been attacked by angry competitors, [character] has not been seen since the games.

events.name: Complications

options.text: [character] is the best option.
[character] is the best option.
No, not this time.

events.text: Nobody can take away the pain of [character] losing his wife, but the court has no difficulty in finding new suitors for [character].

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Courtesan in Consort's Clothes

options.text: Shall we slip away, my love? You feel flushed.
[character] came to me asking for help. I would never engage in such indecency.

events.text: At that evening's festival, you and [character] are gossiping with a few notables when [character] motions for you both to come meet the comely woman at his side who wears the magnificent dress you loaned to [character]. One thing however is very clear, this woman is a stunningly endowed courtesan. [character] stiffens at the sight, and raises a knowing eyebrow. He leans in close and whispers sensually, "You parade that courtesan around in my clothing? I never knew you were so naughty."

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Courtesan in Consort's Clothes

options.text: I can't wait to hear the juicy tales. Enjoy yourself my love. I will keep [character] busy.
[character] came to me asking for help. I would never engage in such indecency.

He leans in close and whispers sensually, "I never knew you'd be so considerate of my tastes. This thrills me beyond words. I will make it up to you somehow."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Crone Killer

options.text: I will not make such a mistake again.

events.text: As the ancient hag advances on your beloved [character], you raise your blade from its resting place beside the throne. Before the crone can utter a word of poisonous magic, you strike her through the heart with the sharp tip of your blade. You order her head placed atop the palace gates, as a warning to all those who dare threaten the family of [character].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dash for Freedom

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Punish the guards for this lack in judgment.

events.text: A pair of city guards accompanies a bound [character] on a short expedition outside the walls of [city]. The gray sky heralds a coming storm. Despite the weather, [character] appears to be a man restored. Lightning flashes, and when the guards turn to look, [character] makes his move! Leaping from a rocky precipice, he dashes into the shadows, never to be heard from again.

events.name: Dash for Freedom

options.text: It was I who granted his request.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Defeated Monkey

options.text: Leave my monkey alone, you monster!

events.text: It is a tale fit for myth. When the adorable court monkey, turned assassin, attempted to murder [character], the two engaged in brutal hand-to-hand combat. [character] managed to hurl the monkey out the open window and into the streets below. Luckily, there is no trail leading from the monkey to you.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Diegylis' Defeat

options.text: I need some rest.

events.text: As soon as the blade is in his hand, Diegylis closes the gap between you with two large strides. You parry his overhead strike but can feel its weight in the deflected blow. Despite his great size, Diegylis is quick on his feet. You continue to circle each other, striking and parrying, until one of his strikes burns in your side and you feel the crunching of bone. Finally you have caught him off balance and you drive your blade deep into his chest, just below the ribs. Diegylis falls slowly to the ground, his gaze fixed upon you, unchanging. After having a thorough look at you, your healers assure you that you will make a full recovery, be it a slow one.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Diegylis' Equal

options.text: You have proven my equal in combat. Will you fight with us?
You may leave these lands a free man, but do not return.
You fight well, Diegylis, but there is only one end for you. Guards...

events.text: As soon as the blade is in his hand, Diegylis closes the gap between you with two large strides. You parry his overhead strike and can feel its weight in the deflected blow. Despite his great size, Diegylis is very quick on his feet. You continue to circle each other, striking and parrying, side-stepping and countering. This goes on for some time, minor wounds inflicted by both parties. As your strikes grow slow and clumsy, you are thankful that your opponent is nearing exhaustion as well.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Diegylis' Revenge

options.text: At least I die in battle.

events.text: As soon as the blade is in his hand, Diegylis closes the gap between you with two large strides. You raise your sword to block his overhead strike, but the force of the blow sends a shock through your body and you fall to one knee. You feel a burning sensation in your chest as Diegylis' next thrust strikes true. You cannot breathe. The ground tilts before you. The last thing you see before your vision fails is your guards swarming your opponent from all sides.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Disbanded

options.text: That could have gone much worse.

events.text: Recognizing your innate authority, your fellow explorers agree to disband for a pittance. Several men stay behind to travel with you to [city], where you must assume the daunting role of [title] of [rival]. The court celebrates your safe return.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Dismal Evening

options.text: Throw him in the streets where he belongs!

events.text: That was quite the dullest evening ever! I should have halted the droning from the orator after the first hour! Three chickens I ate! THREE! In one evening! Plus a great number of dormice. Boredom does that to a ruler.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Eluded by the Beast

options.text: Stay diligent and search methodically until you find a trail.
You know the animals' paths and where they lead.
Use your tracking skills to pick out the right prints on the riverbank.
It escapes you this time. Legends are not easy prey!

events.text: As you chase through the countryside the beast continues to stay one step ahead. Reaching a river, the tracks become muddled and confused amongst those of other creatures. How will you overcome this cold trail?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Escaped the Grave

options.text: I must reflect on my life.
We will stamp the [tribe] from the earth.
Send the cook's head to [character] on a platter.

events.text: Your grieving family surrounds you, watching as the priests prepare your body for the afterlife. Summoning all of your strength, you manage to somehow break free of the poison's toxic spell, and you begin to twitch a finger. Servants cry out in horror as you start to move. Your devoted [character] faints to the floor. You escape the grave by mere moments.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fallen Spymaster: Safe House

options.text: Let me tend to this, I'm sure I can stitch you up.
Thank you for telling me. Rest now, and heal.

events.text: You don a nondescript cloak and make your way out of the palace and through the back alleys of the capital past mangy orphans, pitiful homeless, and wounded veterans. In time, you arrive safely at [character]'s hideout in the slums. You speak with a half delirious [character], and learn from the terribly wounded Spymaster that the plot to Assassinate them failed. Somehow [character] traced it back to him and took his revenge. What shall we do?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fallen Spymaster: Shadows and Blades

options.text: Right, let's just stay alive and away from them.
If I can just get close enough I can take them down.
Charge the bastard and tackle them off the balcony!
Urk. Fate save me.

events.text: That night you are awakened by the sound of steel on stone. You bolt awake, looking around the room. A shadowed figure climbs over the balcony, a short sword gleaming in the moonlight. You spring from your bed, calling for the guards and grab the blade you keep at your bedside. Sweating, heart racing, you prepare to defend your life from the assailant.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fallen Spymaster: Sleepless Night

options.text: I must never let this happen again.
I cannot allow fear to control me.

events.text: That night you sleep restlessly, a sword by your bedside and guards on watch outside your chambers. Thankfully, blessedly, morning comes and news reaches you that [character] has been safely returned to their villa. [character] remains at large and will undoubtedly continue their efforts.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fallen Spymaster: Street Ambush

options.text: I demand you lower your blades at once!

outcomes.label: Fallen Spymaster Street Ambush Option 1 Scarred
Fallen Spymaster Street Ambush Option 1 Xp

options.text: Ah! Time to leave.

events.text: You don a nondescript cloak and make your way out of the palace and through the back alleys of the capital past mangy orphans, pitiful homeless, and wounded veterans. Suddenly, an arrow flys out from the darkness. Your scout goes down with a bloody gurgle, and a few scoundrels leap out at you, rusty weapons at hand and feral grins upon their faces. What shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: False Loyalties

options.text: I will not judge without evidence.
I believe Chancellor [character].

events.text: The widespread mutiny begins to falter, as loyal soldiers rise up to defend [rival] against the traitors. Back at court, [character] accuses [character] of orchestrating the entire affair. Many of the soldiers involved in the uprising have pledged him their loyalty. Of course, all these confessions were obtained using hideous torture. Many in the leadership demand that [character] be arrested for these supposed crimes.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Felling a Myth

options.text: Face it in close quarters, like heroes of old.
Let the trappers do their work.
Such power and grace should not be removed from this world.

events.text: Finally the creature stands before you. Although not quite the myth you were led to believe, the lion stands taller than any you have seen, with powerful muscles moving beneath its taut skin. It prowls back and forth, trapped, judging if you are friend or foe.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Festival for the Freed

options.text: We should bring him to court.

outcomes.label: Festival For The Freed Option 1 Marry
Festival For The Freed Option 1 Lovers

options.text: This seems like trouble.

events.text: A festival is held in celebration of the freed people of [city] as they embark on a new life under [rival]. One of those freed, [character], catches your eye, for he is a rare beauty and intelligent too - according to the officials tasked with administering the newly freed city. A sudden urge strikes you.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Festival for the Freed

options.text: We should bring him to court.

outcomes.label: Festival For The Freed Option 1 Marry
Festival For The Freed Option 1 Lovers

One of those freed, [character], catches your eye, for he is a rare beauty and intelligent too - according to the officials tasked with administering the newly freed city. A sudden urge strikes you.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fit for a Tomb

options.text: There is no one here to comfort me.

events.text: Fleeing from the palace, a small retinue follows [character] into a series of secret chambers beneath [city]. The tunnels are ancient and reek of filth and decay. Many of your group end up lost in the darkness. In a moment of confusion, [character] draws his sword and attacks you and [character] fiercely. He has been behind the whole mutinous affair. Your last moments find you deep underground, alone, and swallowed by blackness fit for a tomb.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fled in the Night

options.text: Be glad that you are finally rid of the traitor.
Send your agents to pursue [character] to the ends of the earth.

events.text: You are awoken by the clamoring of voices and the unmistakable clattering of running guards as they spread out across the city. Moments later, [character] appears before you and explains that [character] has fled to join his paymasters, ferried out of the city by agents from [rival]. [character] unspoken question is clear: Is it time to let [character] go, or will you pursue the traitor?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: For the King

options.text: [character] will remain by my side forever.

events.text: The widespread mutiny begins to falter, as loyal soldiers rise up to defend [rival] against the traitors. As fighting nears the palace, [character] suddenly draws his sword and attacks you. He has been behind the whole affair. With a brave cry, Chancellor [character] leaps in front of the sword, taking the full force of the blow. He collapses on the steps of the court, as [character] is struck down by your bodyguards.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Foreign Influence

options.text: I must confess, I was worried for a moment.

events.text: Much to our surprise, our agents in [rival] have successfully infiltrated the network of the [rival] heir, [character]. Their ability to influence the nation’s leadership now reaches as far as the ruler himself, [character]. We will keep a close watch on additional developments, but it appears that the missions to sway influence in [rival] will yield the desired results.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Foreign Relations

options.text: Guards!
We shall not speak of this.

requirements.label: Schemer / Debauched
tip: The leader must have one of: Schemer; Debauched

options.text: [character], you didn't tell me we had guests. I shall fetch the drinks.

events.text: As you had half suspected, you enter the chamber to find [character] entwined with another... is that [character]?!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Forsaken

options.text: How has it come to this?

events.text: As [character] advances, you call to your loyal guards, awaiting their intervention. None comes. These particular soldiers appear to be part of the conspiracy. They stand aside smugly, as [character] plants the rusty dagger in your chest.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Found Innocent

options.text: All that effort for nothing.

events.text: After a theatrical trial before the local court of [city], [character] declares our emissaries innocent of attempts to overthrow his rule. According to him, these men and women cannot be blamed for the sins of the throne. They will be released.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fresh Eyes

options.text: We must strive for strong diplomacy.
Industry will put us on a productive path.
The world is vast, and we need a ready military.
[rival] is nothing without its people.

events.text: While it has been a refreshing journey abroad, it is time to return to the capital and resume your responsibilities. Your time traveling has inspired you to look at the rule of [rival] with renewed vision. How will you direct this burst of energy?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: From the Rubble

options.text: Tonight, we celebrate. The glory of [rival], and mercy of the fates.
Tonight, we remember. Love and duty must come before all else.

events.text: There is a creak, a rumble, and a rush of wind. The tunnel lies ruined, but you stand with [character] in your arms. Wiping the dirt and sweat from your brow, you address the gathered masses.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Gone Forever

options.text: I will take my sorrow with me to the grave.

events.text: Before you can even cry out, a darkness falls across the chamber, and when your sight returns, [character] is gone. Possibly forever. Perhaps this will teach you to make promises you never intend to fulfil.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Guilty as Charged

options.text: Their deaths are on my head.

events.text: After a theatrical trial before the local court of [city], [character] declares our emissaries guilty of plotting to overthrow his rule. According to him, these men and women are the harmful agents of the [rival] throne. They are executed in [city]'s city square.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Hanging On Every Word

options.text: Speak of [rival] greatness over all others.

events.text: [character] knows how to hold a conversation. Both ends of one, really. You take your leave thankfully when the court calls for a speech to mark the occasion.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Happy Raiders

options.text: All are welcome in [rival].

events.text: Once you get to know them, the shabby highwaymen turn out to be an altogether pleasant band of miscreants. Most of them are simple farmers forced to steal to feed their starving families. Having won their affection, you invite them back to [city], where they are eager to find work and build a better life.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Help Yourself

options.text: Wonderful, and is that five different varieties to try?
I... fear I must retire from the table.

events.text: The feasting, the feasting feels like it will never end. The tenth course beckons, and [character] says, "Oh, you must try the fish sauce, it's a [family] specialty!"

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Hostage Death

options.text: So this is the end...

events.text: Rushing forward, you crash into [character] and [character]. You grab at the blade to save [character], but not quite fast enough. [character] slits [character] across the neck and tosses his body aside. [character] lunges at you, sinking the blade deep into your chest. Blood pours from your wounds as you collapse. Your guards burst into the room, swords drawn, and slam into [character] in full armor. His death comes swiftly. Warmth flows from your body onto the floor, [character] lays on the floor beside you, your blood mixes together as you fade away...

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Hostage Negotiation

options.text: At least it is over now.

events.text: Hours pass as you talk with [character], the dagger mere inches from the throat of [character]. Your guards indicate that they are ready to attack at any time. They have men placed at all the escapes and an archer outside the window with a clear shot. You learn much about [character] that night, as you carry on a companionable conversation, trying against all odds to solve this with words, not violence. Somehow, by a miracle really, [character] turns himself in and is willing to be tried before a judge. [character] is released unharmed, but shaken. [character] has taken refuge with the priests seeking a cure for their ceaseless nightmares of that day.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Hostage Rescue

options.text: Stay with me! I'm so sorry! I didn't mean for this to happen!

events.text: Rushing forward, you crash into [character] and [character]. You grab at the blade to save [character], but not quite fast enough. [character] slits [character] across the neck and tosses his body aside. [character] lunges at you, sinking the blade deep into your shoulder. Blood pours from your wound as you grapple. Your guards burst into the room, swords drawn, and slam into [character] in full armor. [character]'s death comes swiftly as [character] lays on the floor, blood leaking from his neck wound.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Hostage Suicide

options.text: Stay with me! I'm so sorry! I didn't mean for this to happen!

events.text: Hours pass as you talk with [character], the dagger mere inches from the throat of [character]. Your guards indicate that they are ready to attack at any time. They have men placed at all the escapes and an archer outside the window with a clear shot. You learn much about [character] that night, as you carry on a companionable conversation, trying against all odds to solve this with words, not violence. It somehow goes terribly wrong, when [character] stabs [character], and then jumps from the balcony, killing himself.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: I Love It When A Plan Comes Together!

options.text: Victory is sweet indeed…

events.text: Success! [character] has met his end, and your new best friend [character] sits upon the throne. Onward!

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: I Think Not

options.text: No, you!

events.text: A return messenger from [character] is swift. "No, allow me to correct this misunderstanding. Perhaps war means something different in your language, but here in [rival] we do not speak of such matters lightly, or in jest. [rival] is at war, and I look forward to your further correspondence on the matter of your surrender. Yours Dutifully, [character]."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: I am Merciful

options.text: I am glad this all... worked out.
Perhaps we should see just how high a priority they place on this accord?

events.text: Representatives of [rival] do not spare a moment in praising the correction of this misunderstanding, assuring you of the high priority [character] places on continued accord between your peoples.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: If You Say So

options.text: Gods know what he wants, but it has to be better than the alternative.
You know what, [character] can take his considerations and shove them.

events.text: [character] is a shrewd man. He cordially accepts the correction of this 'unfortunate misunderstanding', with hints that perhaps showing future considerations to [rival] would be an advisable path to ensuring such misunderstandings remain in the past.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Intercessional Suspicion

requirements.label: Strong character / Blessed
tip: The leader must have one of: Strong character (a character trait); Blessed

options.text: Gather a rush of strength to fight him off!
Stay calm and call for help.
This is the end.

events.text: You meet alone in your rooms. [character]’s eyes dart around as he enters. “Well met [character]! I have a message from [character]…” [character] takes half a step forwards. “He is sorry that he can’t be here for this.” The knife pierces your side with an intense pressure and an involuntary breath escapes your lips as the air is driven from your body. The shock winds you and [character]’s hands wrap around your throat before you have a chance to react. Moments separate you from death.
